error.PHOTO_EMPTY: This file is empty. Export it again from your photo library or choose the original photo.
error.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: This original exceeds 80MB. Export a smaller JPEG or HEIC photo first.
error.PHOTO_FORMAT: Unsupported format. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, GIF or BMP. Export RAW or TIFF as JPEG first.
error.PHOTO_DECODE: The photo could not be decoded. It may be damaged or unsupported by this browser. Export it as JPEG and add it again.
error.PHOTO_HEIC_DECODE: This HEIC/HEIF photo could not be converted. Retry, or export it as JPEG from your photo library.
error.PHOTO_PIXELS: This photo exceeds 100 megapixels. Export a smaller version for this device.
error.PHOTO_ENCODE: Photo optimization failed. Retry, or close other tabs to free memory and add the photo again.
error.PHOTO_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Photo conversion timed out. Retry, or export it as JPEG and add it again.
error.PHOTO_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT: Upload timed out. The optimized photo is ready; use Retry below it when your connection returns.
error.PHOTO_UPLOAD_SIZE: The optimized photo still exceeds the upload limit. Remove it and add it again.
error.PHOTO_UPLOAD_FORMAT: The upload has an invalid format or still contains metadata. Remove it and add it again to re-optimize.
error.PHOTO_UPLOAD_DIMENSIONS: The optimized dimensions are invalid. Remove the photo and add it again for automatic resizing.
error.PHOTO_COUNT: Each trip supports up to 6 photos. Select fewer files or remove an existing photo first.
